map.输入文本或编号，生成数据矩阵风格的装饰图案（示意用途，不可扫码），纯前端本地生成: Render a Data Matrix–style decorative pattern from text or a part number; a visual mock-up, not a scannable code.
map.文本哈希 hash = Σ 逐字符迭代 ((hash << 5) − hash: Text hash accumulates ((hash << 5) − hash + char code) over 32-bit integers; the pseudo-random sequence starts at seed₀ = |hash| + 1 and iterates seedₙ = (seed × 9301 + 49297) mod 233280; a cell is filled when seed ÷ 233280 > 0.5. The finder pattern mimics Data Matrix: solid left column and bottom row, alternating top row and right column; canvas side = modules × 18 px.
map.生成「数据矩阵风格」的装饰图案：花纹由文本哈希的伪随机序列决定，不含真实数据编码: Generates a Data Matrix–style decorative pattern: the texture comes from the text hash's pseudo-random sequence and contains no real data encoding or Reed-Solomon correction, so scanners cannot read it. Use it for visual mock-ups and layout placeholders only; for a scannable Data Matrix, use a dedicated encoding library.
